source_provenance_note: Full-run module semantics loaded once. These hashes were captured during the run before formatting/indicator optimization; parent confirmed no semantic change between import and capture. Final-source 25-example equality validation is recorded separately.
scope_note: Mainnet movers selected the diagnostic symbols; all replay inputs are SANDBOX archive candles.
activation_reason: Market-profile behavior changed, but no execution/exit/profit model or prospective validation establishes superiority. Focused Q/RED examples expose deliberate rejection boundaries.
stage_comparison_note: Counts are not like-for-like full admission counts. Baseline CANDIDATE has not passed its later historical-move gross reward-risk gate; candidate includes planned cost-adjusted reward-risk. Neither proves an order would open.

validation.synthetic_test_scope: Actual PRICE_VERSION versus STRUCTURE_VERSION full gate path; mutation of unclosed current minute leaves both outputs and input digests unchanged.

comparison_limitations: Retrospective symbol selection, including previous-day same-symbol controls, is not out-of-sample.
Fixed neutral regime scenario does not reconstruct historical full-universe S0.
Original per-minute detector state and actual publication latency are not reconstructed.
Selected live policy keys are frozen; unspecified keys use source defaults.
Baseline PRICE_VERSION/confirmation-v1 is a current-checkout reconstruction, not isolated deployed binary execution.
The two variant stages use different reward-risk models; counts alone cannot establish opening frequency or quality.
No historical tick filters, account budgets, funding approvals, fills, exits, fees, slippage or realized alternate PnL were modeled.
All 63 new-profile eligible observations in this cohort are BREAKOUT; no eligible PULLBACK_RESUME was observed.
